in_sanskrit.name: Qureshi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है The owner of wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Qureshi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Persian word 'khordadh', meaning 'lord of the day'. The name 'Qureshi' translates to 'the owner of wealth'.

in_hindi.name: Qureshi
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है The owner of wealth

in_tamil.name: Qureshi

in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే The owner of wealth

in_marathi.name: Qureshi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे The owner of wealth
